# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 L4 phase 1, the price of union: Florence. Generated by gen_union.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 L4 phase 2 (after the union: Mark of Ephesus, no crowning, Rome's condition, the liturgy in Hagia Sophia; events 20-23) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-20 v6.6 L4 phases 3 and 4 (John V's promise; envoys and scholars: events 1-5) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 22); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.4): set up in the first month (global oe_un_on shuts vanilla flavor_byz.55),
# the end check, bookkeeping, then at most one event in a free month.
oe_un_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_init } } oe_un_init = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_off } }
        oe_un_end_check = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_off } }
        oe_un_book = yes
        # .21 (a new emperor under a union) is sure in the first free month; while it is due nothing else is rolled.
        if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_21 = yes oe_ml_free = yes } oe_un_fire = { n = 21 } }
        else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_need_21 } oe_un_wait_21 = yes }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
            # the first event that is due gets this month's roll (design 3.4): .22 .20 .10, then phases 3-4: .4 .3 .2 .1
            if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_22 = yes } random = { chance = oe_un_ch_22 oe_un_fire = { n = 22 } } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_20 = yes } random = { chance = 20 oe_un_fire = { n = 20 } } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_10 = yes } random = { chance = oe_un_ch_10 oe_un_fire = { n = 10 } } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_un_ch_4 oe_un_fire = { n = 4 } } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = 8 oe_un_fire = { n = 3 } } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = 15 oe_un_fire = { n = 2 } } }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_un_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_un_ch_1 oe_un_fire = { n = 1 } } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. First month: the line is on (global oe_un_on, read by the flavor_BYZ patch of vanilla flavor_byz.55).
oe_un_init = {
    set_variable = oe_un_init
    set_global_variable = oe_un_on
    set_variable = { name = oe_un_st value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { religion = religion:catholic } set_variable = { name = oe_un_st value = 5 } }
    debug_log = "OE_UN init: st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_st')|0]"
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The line closes on 1453.6.1, or when Constantinople has been out of our hands for 24 months in a
# row (a short loss in a civil war or a siege does not close it). Every variable stays for L5, N4 and the chronicle.
oe_un_end_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_lost_m } remove_variable = oe_un_lost_m }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_un_lost_m }
        change_variable = { name = oe_un_lost_m add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_un_lost_m value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { current_date >= 1453.6.1 AND = { has_variable = oe_un_lost_m var:oe_un_lost_m >= 24 } global_var:oe_ecc_fall ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = oe_un_off
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_emperor_away } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_emperor_away }
        location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease } }
        debug_log = "OE_UN closed: st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_st')|0]"
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Bookkeeping, no pop-ups and no lock (design 3.4 item 3, phase-1 part).
oe_un_book = {
    # The empire turned Catholic (vanilla flavor_byz.55 or any other way): state 5, this line's modifiers go.
    if = { limit = { religion = religion:catholic NOT = { var:oe_un_st ?= 5 } } oe_un_set_state = { st = 5 } }
    # The strong route voids the historical events still to come.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_strong } oe_un_strong_now = yes }
        set_variable = oe_un_strong
        debug_log = "OE_UN strong route: the historical events of the union are void"
    }
    # oe_br.9 (John V goes west, 1369): read, never changed. The answer is known once oe_br_union_scandal is on (1 the
    # emperor submitted in Rome: 10 years of talks, as long as oe_br_western_aid), or 3 months after the event fired
    # without it (2 the emperor stayed).
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_br_done_9 NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_rome1369 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_seen_9 } change_variable = { name = oe_un_seen_9 add = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_un_seen_9 value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_br_union_scandal }
            set_variable = { name = oe_un_rome1369 value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_un_st ?= 0 } oe_un_open_talks = { years = 10 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_un_seen_9 >= 3 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_un_rome1369 value = 2 }
        }
    }
    # D4 phase 3: the pope's answer "talk of union again" (global oe_lat_union_promised) -> 10 years of talks, and the
    # council may come early (oe_un_early).
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_union_promised NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_seen_ldp } }
        set_variable = oe_un_seen_ldp
        if = { limit = { var:oe_un_st ?= 0 } oe_un_open_talks = { years = 10 } set_variable = oe_un_early }
    }
    # Phase 2: a change of emperor while a union is in force -> oe_un_need_21, for .21.
    oe_un_emp_check = yes
    oe_un_jewels_sync = yes
    # Windows that passed without their event.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_10 } current_date > 1445.12.31 } set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_10 value = 2 } }
    # Phase 2: months since the emperor came home (.12), up to 3: .20 may come from the third month on.
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_un_done_12 NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_20 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_m12 } } set_variable = { name = oe_un_m12 value = 0 } }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_un_m12 < 3 } change_variable = { name = oe_un_m12 add = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_20 } current_date > 1446.12.31 } set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_20 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_22 } current_date > 1453.4.30 } set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_22 value = 2 } }
    # Phases 3-4: windows that passed. .2 also passes once John V submitted in Rome (oe_br.9 a, read above).
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_1 } current_date > 1358.12.31 } set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_1 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_2 } OR = { current_date > 1369.12.31 var:oe_un_rome1369 ?= 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_2 value = 2 }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_3 } current_date > 1400.12.31 } set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_3 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_constance_envoys NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_4 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_m4 } } set_variable = { name = oe_un_m4 value = 0 } }
        else = { change_variable = { name = oe_un_m4 add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_4 }
            OR = {
                AND = { has_variable = oe_un_m4 var:oe_un_m4 > 18 }
                AND = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_lat_constance_envoys } current_date > 1420.12.31 }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_4 value = 2 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly (phase 2; design 3.4 and 5 item 8). The emperor on record is oe_un_emp (.12 sets it on the way
# home). While no union is in force the reigning emperor is simply recorded, so that a union made later (.22, .23)
# starts from the emperor of its own day. Under a union, a ruler other than the one on record raises oe_un_need_21
# (its value: months waited) for .21, once. Any new ruler counts; D2's oe_ecc.32 (a usurpation, a restoration) runs
# earlier in the month (line 14) and takes the lock, and .21 waits.
oe_un_emp_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_un_made = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_done_21 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_emp } } oe_un_emp_record = yes }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_need_21 } NOT = { var:oe_un_emp ?= { is_ruler_of = c:BYZ } } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_un_need_21 value = 0 }
            oe_un_emp_record = yes
            debug_log = "OE_UN a new emperor while the union is in force: .21 is due"
        }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_need_21 } remove_variable = oe_un_need_21 }
        oe_un_emp_record = yes
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The reigning emperor goes on record.
oe_un_emp_record = {
    ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_un_r }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_un_r } set_variable = { name = oe_un_emp value = scope:oe_un_r } }
}
# BYZ scope, monthly, while .21 is due and could not come (the month is taken, the see is vacant, the emperor is away):
# one more month waited; after more than 6 the event has passed (design 3.4).
oe_un_wait_21 = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_un_need_21 add = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_un_need_21 > 6 }
        remove_variable = oe_un_need_21
        set_variable = { name = oe_un_done_21 value = 2 }
        debug_log = "OE_UN .21 passed: no free month within 6 months of the new reign"
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends an event of the monthly check.
oe_un_fire = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_un_last value = $n$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_un.$n$
}

# BYZ scope. The one way to change the union's state (design 3.6): $st$ 0 none, 2 signed (with reservations when
# oe_un_terms is set), 3 proclaimed, 4 repudiated (10 years), 5 converted. Swaps the state modifiers; a union made,
# void or converted ends the talks.
# fix-g1222 item 1 (r23 g12): an option's preview runs this without executing the set_variable above, so every read of
# oe_un_st below is guarded (`?=`, or has_variable before the comparison); error.log had "var:oe_un_st not set" from .11 a.
oe_un_set_state = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_un_st value = $st$ }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_signed } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_signed }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_signed_soft } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_signed_soft }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_proclaimed } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_proclaimed }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:oe_un_st ?= 4 } has_country_modifier = oe_un_repudiated }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_un_repudiated
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_un_st ?= 2 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_terms } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_signed_soft years = -1 mode = add } }
        else = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_signed years = -1 mode = add } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_un_st ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_proclaimed years = -1 mode = add } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_un_st ?= 4 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_repudiated years = 10 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_st var:oe_un_st >= 2 } oe_un_close_talks = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. Talks of union for $years$ years (design 3.5 "开谈判"): only while no union is in force and the empire is
# not Catholic. Opening again starts the clock again.
oe_un_open_talks = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_st } var:oe_un_st ?= 0 var:oe_un_st ?= 4 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_un_talk value = 1 years = $years$ }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_pledge years = $years$ mode = replace }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The talks end (a union made, void or converted, or the test page).
oe_un_close_talks = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_talk } remove_variable = oe_un_talk }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_pledge } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_pledge }
}
# BYZ scope. Interface for other lines (design 4.2): an option elsewhere that promises Rome union (C8's oe_ths.3 b, by
# hook). Only while nothing was ever signed: 5 years of talks, the papacy +5. Never changes the state.
oe_un_promise = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_st } var:oe_un_st ?= 0 } }
        oe_un_open_talks = { years = 5 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_un_b_talks target = c:BYZ } } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Imperial Authority $amount$ (the same as oe_mo_auth, oe_lat_auth).
oe_un_auth = {
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Gain $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_un_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
# BYZ scope. One more Greek scholar who stayed in Italy (for N4).
oe_un_add_scholar = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_scholars } change_variable = { name = oe_un_scholars add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_un_scholars value = 1 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The crown jewels' two states (decision 59, design 3.8): our global oe_cw_jewels_in_venice decides
# and the vanilla work of art follows it. Pawned (oe_cw.17, oe_cof.7) and redeemed (oe_cof.9) move both already; B2's
# Tenedos bargain only clears the variable. Left alone once vanilla's own Venetian chain has run (Venice keeps
# original_crown_jewels_lender). Each fix is counted (oe_un_jw_fix) and logged, so r15/r16 can see which line missed it.
oe_un_jewels_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:VEN
            exists = work_of_art:byzantine_crown_jewels
            c:VEN = { NOT = { has_variable = original_crown_jewels_lender } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_jewels_in_venice work_of_art:byzantine_crown_jewels = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
            oe_mf_jewels_to_venice = yes
            oe_un_jw_count = yes
            debug_log = "OE_UN jewels: pawned but at home; the work of art goes to Venice"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cw_jewels_in_venice }
                work_of_art:byzantine_crown_jewels = { owner ?= c:VEN location ?= { is_capital = yes owner ?= c:VEN } }
            }
            oe_mf_jewels_home = yes
            oe_un_jw_count = yes
            debug_log = "OE_UN jewels: redeemed but still in Venice; the work of art comes home"
        }
    }
}
oe_un_jw_count = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_un_jw_fix } change_variable = { name = oe_un_jw_fix add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_un_jw_fix value = 1 } }
}

# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_un.90 (var:oe_un_job): 1 a vacancy of the see for the union (.12 a b; D2 reason 7),
# 2 a vacancy for the end of the union (.21 c; D2 reason 8), 3 vanilla flavor_byz.55 (.12 d).
oe_un_do_job = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_un_job ?= 1 } oe_un_vacate_union = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_un_job ?= 2 } oe_un_vacate_void = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_un_job ?= 3 }
        set_variable = oe_un_convert
        trigger_event_non_silently = flavor_byz.55
        debug_log = "OE_UN vanilla flavor_byz.55 called (oe_un.12 d)"
    }
    remove_variable = oe_un_job
}
# BYZ scope. D2 (design 4.3): the see falls vacant for the union (reason 7) while the church framework runs and the
# patriarch is not a unionist. Without the framework no vacancy (no one would hold the synod of .30).
oe_un_vacate_union = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes NOT = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 3 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy } }
        oe_ecc_vacate = { reason = 7 } oe_ecc_offer_party = { f = 3 }
        debug_log = "OE_UN the see falls vacant for the union (D2 reason 7)"
    }
}
# BYZ scope (phase 2, .21 c). D2: the see falls vacant because the union ends (reason 8) while the church framework runs
# and the patriarch is not a hesychast already. Without the framework no vacancy.
oe_un_vacate_void = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ecc_live = yes NOT = { var:oe_ecc_pat_f ?= 1 } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy } }
        oe_ecc_vacate = { reason = 8 } oe_ecc_offer_party = { f = 1 }
        debug_log = "OE_UN the see falls vacant for the end of the union (D2 reason 8)"
    }
}

# BYZ scope (phase 2, .23 immediate). The union is read out in Hagia Sophia: state 3, the patriarchate's standing -5, and
# the City's mood by the opposition at home, kept for L5 in the global oe_un_1452 (1 unease, 2 uproar; 3 is Rome's
# condition refused, .22 c).
oe_un_proclaim_1452 = {
    oe_un_set_state = { st = 3 }
    oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = -5 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_un_opp >= 60 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_un_1452 value = 2 }
        location:constantinople = {
            if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_city_strife years = 3 mode = replace }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_un_1452 value = 1 }
        location:constantinople = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife } }
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_city_unease years = 3 mode = replace }
            }
        }
    }
    debug_log = "OE_UN the union is read out in Hagia Sophia: y1452=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_1452')|0] opp=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_opp')|0]"
}
# BYZ scope (.23 b). The City calms by one step: strife becomes unease, unease goes.
oe_un_city_calm = {
    location:constantinople = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife }
            remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_un_city_unease years = 3 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease }
    }
}
# BYZ scope (.23 c). The City's strife and unease over the union go.
oe_un_city_clear = {
    location:constantinople = {
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife }
        if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_unease }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs).
oe_un_log = { debug_log = "OE_UN st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_st')|0] talk=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_talk')|0] opp=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_opp')|0] bonus=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_west_bonus')|0] will=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_lat_west_will')|0] code=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_state_value')|0] trip=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_trip')|0] done=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_done')|0] c12=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_c12')|0] r1369=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_1369')|0] sch=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_scholars')|0] jw=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_jw')|0] flags=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_flags')|0] last=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_last')|0] ecc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_live_value')|0] mark=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_mark')|0] need21=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_need21')|0] done2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_done2')|0] c21=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_c21')|0] c22=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_c22')|0] c23=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_c23')|0] y1452=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_1452')|0] done3=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_done3')|0] c34=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_c34')|0] f34=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_f34')|0]" }

oe_un_test_trip = {

# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state (the line stays set up), so its events can be tested again.
oe_un_test_reset = {
    oe_un_set_state = { st = 0 }
    oe_un_close_talks = yes
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_repudiated } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_repudiated }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_emperor_away } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_emperor_away }
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_city_strife } }
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_10
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_11
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_12
    remove_variable = oe_un_trip
    remove_variable = oe_un_terms
    remove_variable = oe_un_roll
    remove_variable = oe_un_c12
    remove_variable = oe_un_emp
    remove_variable = oe_un_job
    remove_variable = oe_un_convert
    remove_variable = oe_un_last
    remove_variable = oe_un_strong
    remove_variable = oe_un_off
    remove_variable = oe_un_lost_m
    # phase 2
    oe_un_city_clear = yes
    location:constantinople = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_un_isidore_men } remove_location_modifier = oe_un_isidore_men } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_un_1452 } remove_global_variable = oe_un_1452 }
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_20
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_21
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_22
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_23
    remove_variable = oe_un_mark
    remove_variable = oe_un_roll20
    remove_variable = oe_un_need_21
    remove_variable = oe_un_m12
    remove_variable = oe_un_c21
    remove_variable = oe_un_c22
    remove_variable = oe_un_c23
    # phases 3-4
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_un_school } remove_country_modifier = oe_un_school }
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_1
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_2
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_3
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_4
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_5
    remove_variable = oe_un_c1
    remove_variable = oe_un_c2
    remove_variable = oe_un_c3
    remove_variable = oe_un_c4
    remove_variable = oe_un_c5
    remove_variable = oe_un_council_asked
    remove_variable = oe_un_personal
    remove_variable = oe_un_brides
    remove_variable = oe_un_early
    remove_variable = oe_un_m4
}
# BYZ scope (phase 4). For .5 without .4: the envoys are taken as having asked for a council (a), or for help and
# marriages only (b), and .5 as not yet come.
oe_un_test_c4 = {
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_5
    set_variable = { name = oe_un_c4 value = $c$ }
}
# BYZ scope (phase 2). For .21 without a real change of ruler: the new emperor is taken as seen, and .21 as not yet come.
oe_un_test_need21 = {
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_21
    set_variable = { name = oe_un_need_21 value = 0 }
}
# BYZ scope (phase 2). For .23 without .22: Rome's condition is taken as accepted, and .23 as not yet come.
oe_un_test_c22 = {
    remove_variable = oe_un_done_23
    set_variable = { name = oe_un_c22 value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope (phase 2; design 5 item 8, decision 206). Sets up "a new emperor under a union, in the same month as a reason
# for D2's oe_ecc.32": the union signed (unless one is in force), the new emperor seen (oe_un_need_21), and, while the
# church framework runs with a patriarch and no vacancy, D2's test reason 9 for .32, left to D2's own monthly round (its
# button eccf32 fires .32 at once instead). Expected: next month line 14 sends oe_ecc.32 and takes the month, .21 waits
# (need21 goes up by 1) and comes in the first free month after; replacing the patriarch in .32 puts .30 in between.
oe_un_test_same = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_un_init } } oe_un_init = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_un_made = no } oe_un_set_state = { st = 2 } }
    oe_un_emp_record = yes
    oe_un_test_need21 = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_ecc_live = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_vacancy }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_reason }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_ecc_dep_open }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ecc_dep_reason value = 9 }
        oe_ecc_emp_pick = yes
    }
    debug_log = "OE_UN test: a new emperor under a union and a reason for oe_ecc.32 in one month; need21=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_un_rd_need21')|0] ecc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ecc_live_value')|0]"
}
